Our Story

Central Florida's Screen Enclosure Specialists

Family-owned and permit-pulling since 2004 — we've been building screen enclosures in Central Florida long enough to know what works and what doesn't.

When we started Your Name Screen & Enclosure back in 2004, screen enclosures were already a staple of Florida life — but good ones weren't always easy to find. Permits getting skipped. Aluminum too light for the wind load. Screen installed without knowing the difference between 18×14 and 18×16. We built this company to do it right.

Over twenty years later, we've built hundreds of pool enclosures, screen rooms, and porch enclosures across Central Florida. We've rescreened enclosures we didn't build, and we've rebuilt ones that weren't done correctly the first time. We've seen what fails after five years — and we don't build that way.

Every job we take is permitted and inspected. That's not just a legal requirement — it protects you when you sell your home, file an insurance claim, or ride out a storm. We won't skip that step, and you shouldn't want us to.

Why Homeowners Choose Us

How We Approach Every Job

📋

Permits, Every Time

We handle the permit application, county submission, and inspection scheduling for every structural job. No exceptions.

🏗️

Built for Florida's Weather

We use aluminum and screen rated for Florida's wind load requirements. Your enclosure needs to handle a storm, not just a sunny day.

🔍

Honest Estimates

Written quotes before any work starts. No scope surprises. If something changes mid-job, we talk to you first.

🕐

We Show Up When We Say

We give you a real appointment time and keep it. Your backyard isn't a low priority just because the job is routine for us.

🧵

We Know Screen

Not all screen is equal. We stock standard, no-see-um, Super Screen, and solar mesh — and we'll tell you which is right for your situation.

🛡️

Workmanship Guarantee

If something isn't right with our work, we come back and fix it. That's not a marketing line — it's how we've kept customers for twenty years.
